title: What Makes a Great Reflection? How to Impress on Application Forms and Interviews

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们能赚到除了出卖时间换取金钱之外的收入，那会怎样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家 Marianne Trent 博士，自 2019 年以来，我一直在开发被动和经常性收入来源。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一个令人兴奋的消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many program is now open for enrollment.
sentences.zh: Sophie Foote 的“一对多”项目现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己于 2022 年完成了该项目，此后也支持了两批心理学家完成他们的学习之旅。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的联盟链接加入，你将获得 Sophie 的奖励，以及我提供的额外独家支持套餐，无需额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的 WhatsApp 支持、四次小组智囊团会议、大师班、个性化指导、一份 Fortnum and Mason 的礼物，以及限时的一对一辅导奖励。

sentences.en: Enrollment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名截止日期为 11 月 16 日星期一晚上 10 点。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过描述中链接的我的奖励页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的奖励。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时为你解答。

sentences.en: Have you ever wondered why some reflections seem to catch a supervisor's or recruiter's attention and others just seem to fall a little flat?
sentences.zh: 你有没有想过，为什么有些反思似乎能引起主管或招聘人员的注意，而另一些却显得平淡无奇？

sentences.en: Reflections are a way to show not just what you've done, but what you've learned from those experiences and why it matters.
sentences.zh: 反思不仅是一种展示你做了什么的方式，更是一种展示你从这些经历中学到了什么以及为什么这些经历很重要的途径。

sentences.en: Whether it's in person or on application forms, what is the secret formula for reflecting in a way that really impresses?
sentences.zh: 无论是在面试现场还是在申请表上，能够真正打动人的反思秘诀是什么？

sentences.en: In this episode, I'll share my exact strategies and I'm also going to be chucking in my examples of what works.
sentences.zh: 在这一集中，我将分享我的具体策略，并提供一些有效的示例。

sentences.en: And what really doesn't.
sentences.zh: 以及那些真正无效的示例。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎收听。

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent and it's lovely to have you here.
sentences.zh: 我是 Marianne Trent 博士，很高兴你能来到这里。

sentences.en: One of the most common questions I am asked as a qualified clinical psychologist is when I'm doing the compassionate Q&As for interview and application season
sentences.zh: 作为一名合格的临床心理学家，在面试和申请季进行富有同情心的问答环节时，我被问到最多的问题之一是

sentences.en: or when I am running my aspiring psychologist membership sessions is how can I reflect in a way that really demonstrates that I am not just going through the motions.
sentences.zh: 或者当我主持“有抱负的心理学家”会员会议时，人们常问：我该如何进行反思，才能真正证明我不仅仅是在走过场？

sentences.en: How can I do what I need to be doing at this stage of my career to be getting the green light to proceed to the next stage?
sentences.zh: 我该如何在我职业生涯的这个阶段做我需要做的事情，从而获得进入下一阶段的绿灯？

sentences.en: So the reflecting that we're talking about is, of course, the ability to be able to look at your experiences
sentences.zh: 所以我们谈论的反思，当然是指审视自己经历的能力，

sentences.en: and to think about how they've shaped you and what you've learned from them rather than just your experience of observing the processes involved in what took place.
sentences.zh: 并思考这些经历如何塑造了你，你从中学到了什么，而不是仅仅观察所发生过程的经历。

sentences.en: Ultimately, what we want for you is for you to be compassionate, reflective practitioners.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，我们希望你成为富有同情心、善于反思的从业者。

sentences.en: We don't want you to be robots that aren't affected by the clients you serve, that aren't moved by their distress and that therefore don't really help you to create meaningful,
sentences.zh: 我们不希望你成为不受服务对象影响、不被他们的痛苦所触动，从而无法帮助你创造有意义的机器人，

sentences.en: effective interventions or assessments or treatment plans that help clients to get results.
sentences.zh: 无法制定有效的干预措施、评估或治疗计划来帮助客户获得成果。

sentences.en: And I think one of the best ways to demonstrate that is to be reflective,
sentences.zh: 我认为展示这一点最好的方法之一就是善于反思，

sentences.en: to really think and join up the dots of what being in this role or in these different job roles has been like,
sentences.zh: 真正思考并串联起在这个角色或不同工作岗位上的点点滴滴，

sentences.en: how it's shaped you, how it's affected you, what trace it's left upon you in a good or sometimes in a not so good way.
sentences.zh: 思考它如何塑造了你，如何影响了你，以及它在你身上留下了什么痕迹，无论是好的还是有时不太好的痕迹。

sentences.en: So your ability to reflect both in person, in interviews, in supervision, on job applications
sentences.zh: 因此，你在面试、督导、求职申请中进行反思的能力，

sentences.en: are really going to help you stand out in these incredibly competitive job arenas that you find yourself in.
sentences.zh: 将真正帮助你在你所处的竞争极其激烈的就业领域中脱颖而出。

sentences.en: It might be that you're after an assistant psychologist job, it might be that you're after a trainee job or a PWP training role or even a qualified role for that matter.
sentences.zh: 你可能是在寻求助理心理学家的工作，可能是实习岗位、PWP 培训角色，甚至是合格的专业职位。

sentences.en: And these skills that I'm going to be outlining today could well be the difference that makes the difference for you.
sentences.zh: 我今天概述的这些技能很可能就是让你与众不同的关键。

sentences.en: OK, so let's crack on.
sentences.zh: 好了，让我们开始吧。

sentences.en: What are the key elements that make a really great reflection?
sentences.zh: 构成优秀反思的关键要素是什么？

sentences.en: So firstly, we are going to want to describe the situation, but not in a way that is too wordy.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们要描述情况，但不要过于冗长。

sentences.en: So for example, you might say, when I was working as an assistant psychologist, I worked with a client with severe anxiety.
sentences.zh: 例如，你可以说：当我担任助理心理学家时，我曾与一位患有严重焦虑症的客户合作。

sentences.en: That really helps us set the tone, the flavour, the context.
sentences.zh: 这确实有助于我们设定基调、风格和背景。

sentences.en: We've kind of got an idea of what you were doing, when and in what capacity you were working.
sentences.zh: 我们大致了解了你在做什么，何时以及以何种身份工作。

sentences.en: We only need to be producing the most relevant, important information here.
sentences.zh: 我们只需要在这里提供最相关、最重要的信息。

sentences.en: We don't want to be adding extra, unnecessary detail.
sentences.zh: 我们不想添加额外、不必要的细节。

sentences.en: We certainly don't want to be adding identifiable client information.
sentences.zh: 我们当然也不想添加可识别的客户信息。

sentences.en: The next stage is we're going to be analysing what we have learned from this experience or these experiences.
sentences.zh: 下一阶段是分析我们从这次或这些经历中学到了什么。

sentences.en: So this is where we are beginning to go above and beyond, you know, the building blocks of 2 plus 2 equals 4.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们开始超越“2 加 2 等于 4”这种基础知识的地方。

sentences.en: This is where we're really starting to do something special and to transform the kind of raw ingredients we've been given to something truly exceptional.
sentences.zh: 这是我们真正开始做一些特别的事情，并将我们所拥有的原始素材转化为真正卓越成果的地方。

sentences.en: So you might say, for example, this experience taught me to really use my active listening skills
sentences.zh: 例如，你可以说：这次经历教会了我真正运用我的积极倾听技巧，

sentences.en: and how to adapt my communication skills so that the client could get the best out of the sessions.
sentences.zh: 以及如何调整我的沟通技巧，以便客户能从会话中获得最大收益。

sentences.en: And then an area often overlooked in reflections is how we are going to build on this for the future.
sentences.zh: 然后，反思中经常被忽视的一个领域是我们未来将如何在此基础上进一步发展。

sentences.en: How it's going to connect with us so that we have a different experience or so that we continue to gain from this best practice experience.
sentences.zh: 它将如何与我们联系起来，以便我们有不同的体验，或者我们能继续从这种最佳实践经验中获益。

sentences.en: So you might say, now I've had these experience of interventions working really well.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以说：现在我已经有了这些干预措施非常有效的经验。

sentences.en: It's empowered me to think about how I can really think about the importance of rapport building with clients
sentences.zh: 它赋予了我思考如何真正重视与客户建立融洽关系的能力，

sentences.en: and how to, you know, effective, whether we're doing regular check-ins, whether we're, you know, doing outcome measures
sentences.zh: 以及如何有效地进行常规检查，或者进行结果测量，

sentences.en: so that we're really getting in client feedback so that they can benefit from what we're doing.
sentences.zh: 这样我们就能真正获得客户反馈，让他们从我们的工作中受益。

sentences.en: Ultimately, that's great for the client, but it's also great for our services outcome measures too.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，这对客户来说很好，对我们服务的成果衡量也很好。

sentences.en: What are the common mistakes people are making when they are reflecting?
sentences.zh: 人们在反思时常犯的错误是什么？

sentences.en: Well, the first I would say is being too descriptive, just going on and on and on.
sentences.zh: 嗯，第一个我想说是过于描述性，只是没完没了地叙述。

sentences.en: And, you know, when you're listening to someone do that, it can be really hard to keep track of
sentences.zh: 当你听别人这样做时，真的很难跟上思路，

sentences.en: and you kind of find yourself wondering where it's going and whether they're ever going to get to the point.
sentences.zh: 你会发现自己想知道这到底要说什么，以及他们是否会切入正题。

sentences.en: We also really want to be avoiding just giving the nuts and bolts the bare essentials of what happened,
sentences.zh: 我们也确实想避免仅仅提供所发生事情的琐碎细节和基本要素，

sentences.en: but never kind of offering any insight or anything like a little bit of extra magic on that.
sentences.zh: 却从不提供任何洞察力或额外的东西。

sentences.en: It's just purely descriptive.
sentences.zh: 这纯粹是描述性的。

sentences.en: That is what we don't want to do.
sentences.zh: 那不是我们想做的。

sentences.en: So we don't want to be saying, I observed therapy sessions and I found them really interesting.
sentences.zh: 所以我们不想说：我观察了治疗过程，觉得它们很有趣。

sentences.en: You know, so what?
sentences.zh: 那又怎样呢？

sentences.en: We also don't want to be, you know, too overgeneralised here or, you know, not really making exciting, engaging, insightful comments and reflections.
sentences.zh: 我们也不想在这里过于笼统，或者没有提出令人兴奋、引人入胜、富有洞察力的评论和反思。

sentences.en: We don't want to just be wanging in and that's made me more empathic.
sentences.zh: 我们不想只是随口说一句“这让我变得更有同理心了”。

sentences.en: So it can be really helpful to put in some theory or some models that kind of you are using to shape your thinking.
sentences.zh: 因此，引入一些理论或模型来塑造你的思维方式会非常有帮助。

sentences.en: Perhaps you're linking it back to, you know, psychology theory, you know, key studies that you've learned about in psychology.
sentences.zh: 也许你可以将其与心理学理论或你在心理学中学到的关键研究联系起来。

sentences.en: You know, we're really trying to think about linking that theory and practice and trying to demonstrate that your knowledge isn't just surface level.
sentences.zh: 我们真的在尝试思考如何将理论与实践联系起来，并试图证明你的知识不仅仅停留在表面。

sentences.en: Let's dive in and have a little bit of a look at some examples that aren't quite hitting the mark and some which are better.
sentences.zh: 让我们深入了解一些不太理想的例子，以及一些更好的例子。

sentences.en: So, for example, if somebody said, I observed a client session, which I found interesting and it showed me how CBT works.
sentences.zh: 例如，如果有人说：我观察了一次客户会话，我觉得很有趣，它向我展示了 CBT 是如何运作的。

sentences.en: I would say that lacks depth.
sentences.zh: 我会说这缺乏深度。

sentences.en: It lacks any kind of actual emotional connection.
sentences.zh: 它缺乏任何实际的情感联系。

sentences.en: It lacks any personal insight or resonance to you as a person, a clinician, a human.
sentences.zh: 它缺乏作为一个人、一名临床医生，你个人的洞察力或共鸣。

sentences.en: Let's see if we can come up with something a little bit better.
sentences.zh: 让我们看看能不能想出更好的表达方式。

sentences.en: Observing a CBT session helped me understand how a structured approach can alleviate anxiety.
sentences.zh: 观察 CBT 会话帮助我理解了结构化的方法如何缓解焦虑。

sentences.en: I noticed how the therapist used Socratic questioning, which I later practised under supervision.
sentences.zh: 我注意到治疗师是如何使用苏格拉底式提问的，我后来在督导下练习了这一点。

sentences.en: This experience highlighted the importance of tailoring interventions to individual clients' needs.
sentences.zh: 这次经历突显了根据个人客户需求量身定制干预措施的重要性。

sentences.en: So why is that better?
sentences.zh: 那么为什么这样更好呢？

sentences.en: What are the strengths of an answer like that?
sentences.zh: 这样的回答有什么优势？

sentences.en: I think it's got that clear learning.
sentences.zh: 我认为它有明确的学习点。

sentences.en: It's got some theory and it's got an idea of what we've taken from that experience and how it informs our learning.
sentences.zh: 它包含了一些理论，并说明了我们从那次经历中获得了什么，以及它如何指导我们的学习。

sentences.en: It shows us that that's an active process, that things aren't just happening in a vacuum, that we are being shaped and we are learning and we are growing as we go.
sentences.zh: 它向我们展示了这是一个主动的过程，事情并非在真空中发生，我们在前进的过程中不断被塑造、学习和成长。

sentences.en: And that is what we want.
sentences.zh: 而这正是我们想要的。

sentences.en: Of course, these skills in reflection don't come easily to everybody.
sentences.zh: 当然，这些反思技能并非每个人都能轻易掌握。

sentences.en: It's so dependent on the way that we've been brought up, the kind of conversations that we have with friends, with family, with our supervisors,
sentences.zh: 它非常依赖于我们的成长方式，我们与朋友、家人、主管进行的对话类型，

sentences.en: the kind of developmental opportunities we have had along the way.
sentences.zh: 以及我们一路走来所拥有的发展机会。

sentences.en: So how can we begin to cultivate these skills if it's not already part of our comfortable wheelhouse?
sentences.zh: 那么，如果这些技能还不是我们擅长的领域，我们该如何开始培养它们呢？

sentences.en: One of the top tips I used was that I had a reflective journal.
sentences.zh: 我使用的顶级技巧之一是写反思日记。

sentences.en: And that bad boy would come out, you know, after supervision sessions, after clinical sessions, after delivering neuropsych, after team meetings, after ward round,
sentences.zh: 那个“坏小子”总会拿出来，在督导会议后、临床会话后、进行神经心理学评估后、团队会议后、查房后，

sentences.en: after, you know, discussions with my peers, after lunchtime sometimes, after attending assistant psychologist meetings, it was kind of always with me.
sentences.zh: 在与同事讨论后，有时在午餐时间，在参加助理心理学家会议后，它几乎总是随身携带。

sentences.en: And I'd be able to just jot things down as and when they cropped up for me.
sentences.zh: 我可以在事情发生时随时记录下来。

sentences.en: I was using it to compare and contrast my current self to my future self, to my past selves, to think about what I want to learn, how I can further myself, how I can develop,
sentences.zh: 我用它来比较现在的自己与未来的自己、过去的自己，思考我想学什么，如何提升自己，如何发展，

sentences.en: how has what I've done compared to my previous interventions, what have I learned, what did I notice that I did differently,
sentences.zh: 我所做的事情与之前的干预措施相比如何，我学到了什么，我注意到我做了什么不同的事情，

sentences.en: what did I notice that I'd like to do differently next time?
sentences.zh: 我注意到下次我想做哪些不同的事情？

sentences.en: Another top tip is to seek feedback.
sentences.zh: 另一个顶级技巧是寻求反馈。

sentences.en: That might be from your supervisor, your manager, it might be from your peers.
sentences.zh: 这可能来自你的主管、经理，也可能来自你的同行。

sentences.en: How do they feel that you are developing as a reflective practitioner, both for your journaling and for your supervision sessions?
sentences.zh: 他们觉得你作为一名反思型从业者发展得如何？无论是通过你的日记还是督导会议？

sentences.en: It might be that you're asking questions like, what did I learn?
sentences.zh: 你可能会问这样的问题：我学到了什么？

sentences.en: What could I do better?
sentences.zh: 我能做得更好吗？

sentences.en: How was I shaped by this experience?
sentences.zh: 这次经历如何塑造了我？

sentences.en: And of course, thinking about actual models for reflecting can be a really useful thing to do as well.
sentences.zh: 当然，思考实际的反思模型也是非常有用的。

sentences.en: Please do let me know in the comments if an additional video on different reflecting models might be helpful, such as the Gibbs reflective cycle, as using methods like that
sentences.zh: 如果关于不同反思模型的额外视频会有帮助，请在评论中告诉我，例如吉布斯反思循环，因为使用这样的方法

sentences.en: can really help you to structure your answers and to maximise your progress.
sentences.zh: 可以真正帮助你构建答案并最大限度地提高你的进步。

sentences.en: Whether you are watching or listening to this content, it would be so gratefully received if you could like, drop a comment or just let me know
sentences.zh: 无论你是观看还是收听此内容，如果你能点赞、发表评论或让我知道，我将不胜感激

sentences.en: what your top tips for reflecting are.
sentences.zh: 你反思的顶级技巧是什么。

sentences.en: How have you been able to supercharge your skills for reflection?
sentences.zh: 你是如何提升自己的反思技能的？

sentences.en: And how are you reaping the benefits?
sentences.zh: 你又是如何从中获益的？

sentences.en: So to summarise, a great reflection will include description, analysis, with the application being what you've learned and what you hope to apply in future.
sentences.zh: 总结一下，一个伟大的反思将包括描述、分析，并将所学到的内容以及希望在未来应用的内容作为应用部分。

sentences.en: And really, we've got to do this super, super regularly.
sentences.zh: 而且，我们必须非常、非常定期地这样做。

sentences.en: We've got to be weaving this in to our day-to-day, moment-to-moment practices.
sentences.zh: 我们必须将其融入到我们日常、每时每刻的实践中。

sentences.en: It might be that you're thinking about this when you're showering, when you're cooking, when you're running, when you're on the treadmill.
sentences.zh: 你可能在洗澡、做饭、跑步或在跑步机上时思考这个问题。

sentences.en: You know, this could be cropping up at random times.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这可能会在随机的时间出现。

sentences.en: I used to reflect a lot when I was driving and stuck in traffic.
sentences.zh: 我过去在开车或堵车时经常反思。

sentences.en: And we're going to need to come back to this.
sentences.zh: 我们需要回到这一点。

sentences.en: It is not a one-and-done approach.
sentences.zh: 这不是一次性的方法。

sentences.en: If you've got kind of stock answers that you use on application forms, then we're going to need to keep checking those because I honestly believe that we ought to be changing,
sentences.zh: 如果你在申请表上使用现成的答案，那么我们需要不断检查它们，因为我真心认为我们应该改变、

sentences.en: growing, shaping, and just, you know, becoming a better and better human and clinician, you know, from day-to-day, week-to-week.
sentences.zh: 成长、塑造，并从每天、每周开始，成为一个更好的人和临床医生。

sentences.en: So we shouldn't just be wanging in those same job applications or same kind of doctorate applications each year.
sentences.zh: 所以我们不应该每年都提交同样的求职申请或同样的博士申请。

sentences.en: I would urge you to have regular reviews and check-ins with yourself and with your supervisor because your skills and your practices across the board, including in reflection,
sentences.zh: 我敦促你对自己和主管进行定期的审查和检查，因为你的技能和实践，包括反思，

sentences.en: should be advancing all of the time.
sentences.zh: 应该一直在进步。

sentences.en: I really hope that you find this content helpful.
sentences.zh: 我真心希望你觉得这些内容有帮助。

sentences.en: If you do, please do take a moment to like the content, to engage with it, to comment, to share, to tell your friends.
sentences.zh: 如果是这样，请花点时间点赞、互动、评论、分享，并告诉你的朋友。

sentences.en: It really is the kindest free thing you can do.
sentences.zh: 这真的是你能做的最友善的免费事情。

sentences.en: If you did want to buy me a cup of herbal tea to say thank you, then please do check out the link in any of my social media bios.
sentences.zh: 如果你想请我喝杯花草茶以示感谢，请查看我社交媒体简介中的链接。

sentences.en: Please do also come along to my free Facebook group,
sentences.zh: 也请加入我的免费 Facebook 群组，

sentences.en: The Aspiring Psychologist Community.
sentences.zh: “有抱负的心理学家社区”。

sentences.en: And if it's your time and you're ready for the next step, please do consider
sentences.zh: 如果时机成熟，你准备好迈出下一步，请考虑

sentences.en: The Aspiring Psychologist Membership, which you can join from just £30 a month with no minimum term.
sentences.zh: “有抱负的心理学家会员资格”，每月仅需 30 英镑，无最低期限要求。

sentences.en: The Aspiring Psychologist Collective and The Clinical Psychologist Collective are also really great books, which will help you to build on your reflective practice
sentences.zh: 《有抱负的心理学家集体》和《临床心理学家集体》也是非常棒的书籍，它们将帮助你建立反思实践，

sentences.en: and to see how others put that into practice too.
sentences.zh: 并了解其他人是如何将其付诸实践的。

sentences.en: If you need to reflect on grief or on autism, then please do check out
sentences.zh: 如果你需要反思悲伤或自闭症，请查看

sentences.en: The Grief Collective and The Autistic Anthology.
sentences.zh: 《悲伤集体》和《自闭症选集》。

sentences.en: If you're looking to become a psychologist,
sentences.zh: 如果你想成为一名心理学家，

sentences.en: then let this be your guide.
sentences.zh: 让这成为你的指南。

sentences.en: With this podcast that's your side, you'll be on your way to being qualified.
sentences.zh: 有这个播客在你身边，你将走上获得资格的道路。

sentences.en: It's The Aspiring Psychologist Podcast with Dr. Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 这是 Marianne Trent 博士的《有抱负的心理学家播客》。

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们能赚到除了出卖时间换取金钱之外的收入，那会怎样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家 Marianne Trent 博士，自 2019 年以来，我一直在开发被动和经常性收入来源。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一个令人兴奋的消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many Program is now open for enrolment.
sentences.zh: Sophie Foote 的“一对多”项目现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己于 2022 年完成了该项目，此后也支持了两批心理学家完成他们的学习之旅。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的联盟链接加入，你将获得 Sophie 的奖励，以及我提供的额外独家支持套餐，无需额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalised guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的 WhatsApp 支持、四次小组智囊团会议、大师班、个性化指导、一份 Fortnum and Mason 的礼物，以及限时的一对一辅导奖励。

sentences.en: Enrolment closes on Monday, the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名截止日期为 11 月 16 日星期一晚上 10 点。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过描述中链接的我的奖励页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的奖励。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时为你解答。
